lock.title: Lock this account?
lock.message: {{name}} ({{email}}) will be logged out on every device and cannot log in until the account is unlocked.

unlock.title: Unlock this account?
unlock.message: {{name}} ({{email}}) will be able to log in again.

makeAdmin.title: Make this user an administrator?
makeAdmin.message: {{name}} ({{email}}) will be able to manage users and default categories. The change applies within 15 minutes.

removeAdmin.title: Remove administrator rights?
removeAdmin.message: {{name}} ({{email}}) becomes a normal user. The change applies within 15 minutes.

done.lock: {{name}} is locked and logged out everywhere.

categories.title: Default categories
categories.intro: Every new account gets a copy of these categories. Changes here do not touch the categories of existing users.
categories.caption: Default categories: {{count}}
categories.keywordsHelp: Separated by commas, up to 50 keywords of 40 characters each, e.g. pho, bun bo, cafe
categories.keywordsTooLong: Up to 50 keywords, each at most 40 characters.
categories.deleted: {{name}} deleted. Users who already have it keep their copy.

confirmDelete.title: Delete this default category?
confirmDelete.message: New users will no longer get "{{name}}". Users who already have it keep their copy.
